name: device-lost-slow-driver
about: The graphics device lost on the stage's second frame, and the new device takes 12 s more to make, as a driver on a loaded machine can (GALAXY_TEST_REBUILD_DELAY_MS): the game makes no frame meanwhile, and that is no stall, as the stall watchdog leaves a rebuild out for up to 60 s (N-1072). The game then goes on to its end.
